economic_hypothesis: A demand shock from a bounded sixty-session base only defines a potential leader. The tradable state occurs after a two-to-twenty-session pullback with lower turnover, when completed price again exceeds the preceding three-session ceiling while the causal market and PIT industry remain healthy.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open
ignition: frozen V20 outcome-blind quiet-base demand-shock candidates
industry: trigger-day PIT industry median ret20>0 and positive share>50%

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

rules.R3_LOW_SUPPLY_PULLBACK: R1 and previous turnover<=0.8x preceding20 mean
rules.R4_STRONG_REACCELERATION: R1 and return>=2%, location>=75%, turnover>=preceding3 mean

trigger.identity: first qualifying completed session per ignition
trigger.reacceleration: close > preceding3 high, return>=1%, location>=65%, turnover>=0.8x preceding3 mean
